s.note: a twisted doughnut from the island of Jersey
s.how: Rub 50g butter into 250g flour, add 50g sugar and 2 eggs and knead. Rest an hour, roll out, cut strips, slit and twist through. Fry at 175C until golden and dust with sugar and nutmeg.
Fold 250g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chives and a pinch of cayenne. Toast 4 slices white bread, butter and cut into fingers. Pile the crab on top.

m.how: Boil 800g new potatoes with mint and toss in salted butter. Pan-fry 4 white fish fillets until golden. Brown 60g butter, add 1 tbsp capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the fish.

w.how: Put 100g short grain rice, 800ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g sugar and a split vanilla bean in a dish. Bake at 150C for 2 hours, stirring twice. Grate nutmeg on top. Serve warm, curtains drawn.

d.note: always a pot of tea on the tray
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Serve on a tray with milk and sugar. Keep the curtains closed.
